description: Unit tests for net::HostResolverInternalResult and its derived classes, testing serialization, deserialization, and correctness of various result types including data, metadata, error, and alias results.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalResult
classes.description: Base class representing different types of host resolution results, including data, metadata, error, and alias results.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalDataResult
classes.description: Represents a successful data result with domain name, query type, endpoints, strings, hosts, and expiration info.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalMetadataResult
classes.description: Represents metadata results containing connection endpoint metadata and related info.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalAliasResult
classes.description: Represents an alias result pointing to another domain.

classes.name: HostResolverInternalErrorResult
classes.description: Represents an error result with error code and related info.

methods.name: FromValue
methods.description: Deserializes a base::Value into a specific HostResolverInternalResult subtype.

methods.name: ToValue
methods.description: Serializes the result into a base::Value for logging or storage.

methods.name: AsData
methods.description: Returns a reference to the object as a data result.

methods.name: AsMetadata
methods.description: Returns a reference to the object as a metadata result.

methods.name: AsAlias
methods.description: Returns a reference to the object as an alias result.

methods.name: AsError
methods.description: Returns a reference to the object as an error result.

methods.name: domain_name
methods.description: Returns the domain name associated with the result.

methods.name: query_type
methods.description: Returns the DNS query type associated with the result.

methods.name: expiration
methods.description: Returns the optional expiration time for the result.

methods.name: timed_expiration
methods.description: Returns the optional timed expiration for the result.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Returns the source of the result (e.g., DNS).

methods.name: endpoints
methods.description: Returns the list of IP endpoints for data results.

methods.name: metadatas
methods.description: Returns the map of priorities to connection endpoint metadata.

methods.name: alias_target
methods.description: Returns the target domain for alias results.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the error code for error results.
